record.question: The nurse is counseling a couple in their mid 30's who have been unable to conceive for about 6 months. They are concerned that one or both of them may be infertile. What is the best advice the nurse could give to the couple?
options: "It is no unusual to take 6-12 months to get pregnant, especially when the partners are in their mid-30s. Eat well, exercise, and avoid stress."
"Start planning adoption. Many couples get pregnant when they are trying to adopt."
"Consult a fertility specialist and start testing before you get any older."
"Have sex as often as you can, especially around the time of ovulation, to increase your chances of pregnancy."
